_about: Persona and memories, second try (2026-10-23), as a short second stage on top of g26 instead of a run from zero. g26m (persona calls mixed into a full run) learned the memory part (false memories: played along 6 of 16, g26 14 of 16) but lost the rest: much quieter, late, 8/12 on the quiz and 2/12 with a persona prompt, where it dodged questions with persona chatter. Changes: starts from g26's adapter and trains 150 steps at half the learning rate; the new persona calls (170, each once) are mixed with 400 of g26's own training calls so it keeps its timing; the writer now gives every false-memory claim its own scenario (half of g26m's were 'remember Vegas'), writes ordinary people instead of gimmicks, and has every call answer at least one question directly.
name: g26m2
